label: BUG-MEMORY-008 — buildCommunities safety guard + single-tx edge invalidation
summary: Fixed BUG-MEMORY-008: buildCommunities() now refuses to run when live level-0 communities exist unless {force:true} is passed. When forced, community invalidation, MEMBER_OF edge invalidation, and re-insertion all run in a single transaction — no crash window between wipe and recreate.
